title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week’s spotlight is The Weeknd’s “Blinding Lights” — a soaring synth-pop anthem with a driving pulse and a rush of cinematic golden-hour energy. It gives Djembe a bright, danceable feature moment for the room: euphoric, memorable, and impossible not to sing along to.
songListNote: The Weeknd’s synth-pop smash — a bright, euphoric, dance-ready boost of energy joining the show rotation.
